html:
I’m pleased to announce the last go-round of my free Beta Reader Program for DEAD SHIFT. I just need you to add my email address (Richard.phillips@secondship.net) to your Amazon account’s Approved Document Senders list and then email me with your kindle’s email address (something@kindle.com).  Then I will push the free Beta draft to your device.  All I ask is that you not share this draft beyond your immediate family and that you let me know your general impressions of the novel.
Best,
Richard Phillips

replies.author: Michael Gaddis
replies.html: Thanks for giving me the chance to be a Beta Reader for Dead Shift. I really enjoyed reading it. The pacing was great. I found the computer science aspect very interesting, especially the amount of storage required for an AI. I never considered the fact that an AI may need a massive amount of hard drive space and that it could be a limiting factor in mobility across networks. I actually haven’t read the Rho Agenda series and I am looking forward to see how The Rho Agenda Inception feeds into the original trilogy.

comments.author: Richard Phillips
comments.html:
Thanks Michael. Glad you enjoyed it. Don’t worry, Jack and Janet play a big role in all of the Rho books.
Best,
Richard
